title: DAAD Helmut-Schmidt-Programme (Master's Scholarships for Public Policy and Good Governance)

eligibility_rules.evidence_quote: Graduates from developing and emerging countries (see DAC list of ODA recipients) with a first university degree.
Applicants must hold a first university degree (Bachelor or equivalent) obtained no more than six years before application.
Above-average academic performance in the first university degree (at least equivalent to German grade 2.5 or higher).
Very good English language skills (minimum IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 80) or German language skills depending on program.

document_requirements.instructions: DAAD application form and a current Europass academic CV (maximum 2 pages).
Detailed letter of motivation (max 2 pages) containing precise academic and personal reasons for wanting to study in Germany.
Official transcript of records from completed Bachelor's degree including grading scale and certified English or German translation.
Certified copy of university degree certificate with official HEC attestation and translation.
One current letter of recommendation from a university lecturer or current employer with official letterhead and stamp.
Official IELTS (Academic) or TOEFL score report taken within the last two years.
